chestsort - chests that sort themselves by name (shroudlink mod)
==================================================================
Rename a chest to one or more categories, e.g. "Food", "Ores & Gems" or "Weapons, Armor".
Hold R at the chest or use a Quick Stack Station: every item of those categories goes in,
even items the chest does not hold yet. Equipped items, the item in your hand and the
action bar are never put away. Works for every player, no addon needed.

The categories are in chestsort_categories.json in the server folder. It is created with
the defaults on the first start; edit it and the changes apply within seconds. With the
player addon, MODS > Chest categories lists them and finds the category of any item.

REQUIRES the shroudlink core (shroudlink-core.zip).

INSTALL: unpack this zip into the server folder (where enshrouded_server.exe is), so that
chestsort.dll lands in shroudlink_mods. To switch it off, remove chestsort.dll.

More: https://github.com/bjck/shroudlink/blob/main/docs/wiki/Players-Features.md
